verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no documented free plan or trial for ClickHouse Cloud. However, the open-source engine runs free on your own machine "to build, test, and experiment" via a single-binary install or clickhouse-local, and community users report real workloads on a single desktop at near-zero cost. On Cloud, usage-based pricing scales to zero when idle, but that limits cost rather than providing a free tier. Missing for 10: an explicit free Cloud tier or trial with documented limits and credits, and independent reports of prototyping on a free managed tier.
